headline: Uber and Zipline launch drone deliveries in Texas
summary: Uber Eats officially launched drone delivery in partnership with Zipline, starting in the Houston suburb of Spring, Texas, with Dallas next and dozens more US cities planned. The companies aim to reach one million drone deliveries a day by the end of 2029.

claims.statement: Uber Eats started drone deliveries in Texas.

sources.quote: Uber Eats is officially launching drone delivery in partnership with Zipline starting Tuesday. The initial rollout begins in the Houston suburb of Spring, Texas, with Dallas next in line and dozens of additional US cities planned.
